title: Report Clarification
content:
Do not infer a user's intended population, date, metric, units, chart or axis. Present exact choices and require review before execution. Unknown wording is not an executable rule. Missing catalogue entries do not prove absence from Snowflake.

Source: Tom's Self-Analytics Requirements, 2026-11-06

title: Orders And Deliveries
content:
Acknowledged means a deposit has been paid; paid means delivered or collected. SALES_PERFORMANCE also contains cancelled invoices. Confirm status, credited-invoice treatment and date basis separately.

Source: .claude/carsupermarket_intel_hub.md; .claude/uk_dbt.md

title: Price Comparisons
content:
Interest-free prices are inflated to absorb finance subsidy. Exclude interest-free deals from mixed price averages, or isolate them in a separate sales-type group. Cancelled-order prices may be placeholders even when reconstructed at order time; exclude them from price averages. Actual cost and GPU metrics have different populations: do not automatically apply price exclusions to everything.

Source: .claude/carsupermarket_intel_hub.md; .claude/uk_dbt.md

title: Advertised And Paid Prices
content:
The advertised price includes the standard mandatory admin fee. The price actually paid may include a different charged fee and discount. Use explicitly named model columns. Do not add the example HTML's historical £199 fee to today's columns or double-count a fee already included.

Source: .claude/uk_dbt.md; buyer_estimates_vs_actual.html; sales_performance__p.sql

title: Buyer Comparison Cohorts
content:
Compare buyer, original and actual values on matched rows when the question is like-for-like. A missing estimate must not silently become zero or actual cost. title: Historical Channels
content:
The example groups supplier Z001 as BCB and excludes DPARVAL, DPSANTAN and DPLEX as consignments. It also excludes buybacks. This builder must not reinterpret those as the current supplier_channel values. An exact recreation needs confirmed mapping and a verified buyback field.

Source: buyer_estimates_vs_actual.html

title: Weighted Averages And Rates
content:
Recompute averages from underlying rows when filtering; never average subgroup averages without counts. A period rate is generally sum(numerator)/sum(denominator), with an explicit zero-denominator policy. Daily stock snapshots must not be added up as if they were transactions.

Source: .claude/carsupermarket_intel_hub.md; data/ai_knowledge_seed/daily_summary.md

title: Portal Enquiry Conversion
content:
DAILY_SUMMARY at_portal_enquiries counts deduplicated enquiries. at_portal_orders_from_enquiries deliberately includes orders attributed to duplicate enquiries, by enquiry date. Keep that asymmetry; the latest enquiry may be the one that converted.

Source: .claude/uk_dbt.md

title: Costs And Margin
content:
Management accounts costs are already negative; late_costs are positive and negated once in compute. Add negative gpu_m_costs to reduce margin. Use AutoView-derived costs and writedowns, not reconstructed mutable transaction splits. Confirm per-vehicle versus total and sign conventions. WBR's confirmed 2026-11-05 decision uses Snowflake gpu_m, gpu_s, gpu_ms and gpu_msb; the assumed £495 recon fallback was removed. Apex supplies total vehicle costs; AutoView supplies the recon/other breakdown. Historical reconciliation found shared AutoView records across multiple Apex stock IDs, so do not assume those identifiers are one-to-one. Older AutoView coverage and frozen sheets may differ from restated current models.

Source: .claude/uk_dbt.md; docs/wbr_report_discrepancies.md

title: Valuation Benchmarks
content:
CAP Clean is the trade/purchase benchmark. Autotrader is the retail/selling benchmark. CAP Retail is available but not the usual benchmark. Confirm valuation date and mileage rather than substituting today's valuation.

Source: .claude/carsupermarket_intel_hub.md

title: Source Grain And Joins
content:
Raw __s models map to SOURCE_*; compute __c to COMPUTE_*; product __p to PRODUCT_*. Suffixes are not Snowflake table names. Read both model definitions before choosing a join. Preserve row grain; DISTINCT is not a repair for multiplied joins. Vehicles stock evolution is per vehicle per day.

Source: .claude/uk_dbt.md; common_dbt_skills_packages compute/product/raw validation references

title: Source Time And Freshness
content:
S3 partition export timestamps describe ingestion run time, not the business event date. UK local time is used. DEV is not refreshed by the PROD schedule. For actively rebuilt tables, last_altered distinguishes same-day rebuilds; a transform DATE cannot.

Source: .claude/ingestion.md; .claude/uk_dbt.md

title: Raw History And Backfills
content:
Rolling lookbacks cannot recover outages longer than their window. Historical full refresh depends on retained S3 files. Raw models preserve source formats; business changes belong in compute. AutoView sales disappearing from a later complete period extract represent credits; latest-row-per-stock can resurrect them.

Source: .claude/ingestion.md; .claude/uk_dbt.md

title: Unavailable Data
content:
If a required measure is not mapped, identify the exact missing measure, grain, period and join key. Check current models/schema before declaring it absent. Possible owners/sources include marketing workbooks for spend/enquiries, Cars Bought for original estimates, AutoView for actual costs, and finance for subsidy. No cross-source join or fallback is inferred. The Obeya documentation identifies DOC Orders, Staff Numbers, Outbound Calls, Price Changes and AutoConvert CS / CSMF as Daily Spend And Enquiries sources at that time. Recheck current Snowflake coverage before treating that historical list as current.

Source: tools/obeya_charts/README.md; docs/wbr_report_discrepancies.md; .claude/uk_dbt.md

title: Documentation Authority
content:
Historical WBR comparisons and the buyer example document specific periods and assumptions. Engineering improvement plans are proposals, not verified business facts. Setup/deployment credentials, assistant permissions and generic sample glossary definitions are not analytical rules. The historical WBR glossary describes GPU-MS as metal plus services and distinguishes Awaiting Arrival, Trade, Reserved and Courtesy stock. Held is explicitly undefined. Its DIS label appears in different contexts, so confirm days in stock, days advertised or days to sale and their dates rather than treating every DIS label alike.

Source: C:/Git Markdown Review, 2026-11-06
